coordinateSystem: Original PNG pixels; origin top-left, x rightward, y downward. Centers and extent boxes are visual locators, not physical measurements. Boxes are [left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive].
method: Opened original, then a single source-only band enlargement.
Individually followed rounded contour extents; did not infer a regular row/column lattice.
Full means a visually identifiable whole glyph extent, not a mathematically reconstructed circle. Small scan breaks remain breaks; no closure is drawn or asserted.
A numerical white-area locator was used only to refine original-pixel positions. Neither connected black strokes nor connected white interiors constitute a particle count.
Sharp interstices, merged white areas and border contacts lacking an independently recoverable extent are not silently counted as one particle or discarded.
countMeaning: The 53 full and 4 partial entries are a located lower bound, not the complete population, a replacement target count, or permission to omit anything. Three other uniquely located border-contact sites have unresolved full/partial classification. Additional regions do not admit a unique site decomposition.

unresolvedLocations.description: Angular/open white area between the left-center rounded glyphs and D03; curved segments and sharp interstices do not determine whether an additional individual glyph is present or how its extent closes.
Central-right irregular opening below M06/M07 and between L07/L08. It cannot be uniquely assigned to an additional particle rather than connected interparticle space from these pixels.
Right-lower angular merged area between D09, D10 and the lower row. A one-glyph decomposition would require choosing an unobserved closure.

Open contour/interstice network among T02-T06 and the next two levels. The listed rounded extents remain individually locatable, but residual branches and small angular openings cannot certify absence of other partial glyphs.

Upper-bar contact and gaps around T07-T12, including T10/T12 and the rightmost wedge at approximately (310,274). Full/partial border classification is unresolved; the wedge is not assumed to be a particle.

Bottom-bar interstices and residual arc fragments across the entire lower edge, including B06 and the rightmost opening near (303,358). These are not automatically extra particles, but neither can an exact partial-edge population be certified.
Small sharp openings around the right-middle glyphs, notably (254,291), (278,294) and the irregular area near (293,304). A white opening by itself does not establish an additional particle site.

coverage.purpose: All upper-interface rounded loci and unresolved border/interstice residuals.
All upper-middle loci, side-edge sites and open residuals.
All lower-middle loci and the three specifically ambiguous interior regions.
All bottom loci and residual edge openings.
